standards.title: Execution invocation and outcome must be independently recorded, never inferred from scheduler-claimed state
Scheduler/trigger-liveness health and outcome/yield health must remain independently representable
Promotion/soak qualification evidence must be structurally verifiable, reset-traceable, and gate-drift-detectable
Exclusivity/ownership markers must be validated by structurally observable proof

artifacts_note: Unlike ui-standards-v1.0 and data-ontology-standards-v1.0, no agent-facing layer (tools/operations_agent_layer.py, standards/operations/ratified-index.json, standards/operations/agent-checklist.json, docs/operations/constitution.md) has been built for this domain as of this freeze. The four standards exist only as raw JSON files plus standards/operations/README.md. This is a known, explicitly-flagged gap relative to the other two frozen domains, not an oversight silently omitted -- see the freeze release notes and the corresponding Standards Clank project-status assessment for the recommendation to build it as a follow-up, separately-authorized task.
evidence_and_review_chain: docs/operations/pass0/ (Pass 0A evidence inventory + Pass 0B adversarial adjudication)
docs/operations/pass1/ (Pass 1 drafting of OPS-A/B/C + the OPS-D scope-omission resolution)
docs/operations/pass2/ (Pass 2 adversarial review of OPS-A/B/C plus the pre-draft OPS-D candidate)
docs/operations/pass2.5/ (Pass 2.5 drafting of OPS-D as STD-OPS-COM-004)
docs/operations/pass3/ (Pass 3 ratification survey of all four standards)

hold: Lifecycle-state model: BLOCKED is prose, not code (cluster 14)

known_review_path_note: STD-OPS-COM-004 followed a different review path than the other three: Pass 2 adversarially reviewed the pre-draft OPS-D candidate and issued drafting constraints, rather than reviewing the finished STD-OPS-COM-004.json text the way COM-001/002/003 were each individually reviewed after drafting. Recorded in decisions/0017-ops-com-004-decision.md and the Pass 3 ratification survey; the operator ratified COM-004 as written with this note visible, not unaware of it.
change_policy: Post-freeze normative Operations changes go through normal governance and result in a new standard, a versioned revision, a supersession, or a retirement. This manifest and the operations-standards-v1.0 tag are immutable historical records and must never be rewritten; future corpus state may legitimately diverge from v1.0. Held/deferred/rehomed concerns (see held_set_excluded_from_v1) may return through normal governance if their reopening triggers occur -- see docs/operations/holds-disposition.md's 'What would reopen this document' section.
